title: Collateral Dungeon
description:
Collateral Dungeon is a tactical puzzle dungeon crawler. Explore as an archaeologist trapped in your most recent dig: an enemy-infested dungeon. However, you are a lover, not a fighter. Without weapons, you must turn to your wit and clever traps to defeat enemies lest you relive your failings.

EXPLORE

Explore procedurally generated dungeons.

TRAP ENEMIES

Place traps to ensnare your foes.

REWIND TIME

Rewind time if your enemies find you, or you stumble into your own traps.

 Discover Relics
Discover relics from the past, present, and future.

Features• Procedurally Generated Dungeons

• Turn-based tactics

• Grid-based movement 

• Arcade mode for endless replayability
